text:
Maya: quick flag noticing hot tenants thrash: prefetch -> soft-evict -> re-prefetch. thinking about a tiny "leaseback" token on demote so clients can reattach cheap. read-only by default. thoughts? :thinking_face:

Vikram: Sounds promising. Key Qs: how do we avoid stale reads after writes? how does it interact with handoff?

Maya: plan: store a reclaim token + epoch on demote. reclaim path verifies token CAS & epoch==committed. if mismatch -> fail reclaim -> normal prefetch. no slab pin.

Sam: agree need CAS. also ensure leaseback never serves writes. and if CAS loses, loser should return a soft fallback not block.

Aisha: config suggestions: leaseback.window_ms=1000, leaseback.max_reclaims=2, mode="read-only". tenant opt-out for strict_consistency.

Vikram: add per-shard reclaim_budget with decay to stop stampedes. metrics: kv.leaseback.requests/success/stale_rejects/cas_conflicts.

Maya: API behavior: client requests leaseback; server returns 200+header X-Cache-Reclaim: leaseback or 202 X-Cache-Reclaim: prefetch_needed. prefer non-blocking fallback.

Sam: tests: unit CAS+epoch, handoff integration, chaos kill mid-reclaim. rollout behind flag, small canary.

Aisha: also gate by write-rate moving avg. disable for write-heavy prefixes. expose tenant-level knob.

Maya: action items: @Vikram prototype CAS+metrics, @Sam add client error codes + examples, @Aisha add heuristics + tenant config. I'll draft RFC + sim script.

evict-bot: created INF-2341 leaseback-reclaim-prototype assigned Maya,Vikram,Sam,Aisha. canary/0.5pct.
